Introduction

MYNAME is a five-member South Korean boy group that debuted on October 27, 2011 with the single “Message” under H2media. After their contracts with H2media expired on December 3, 2019, the group parted ways with the agency. However, member Seyong clarified that the group had not disbanded. MYNAME continued their activities in Japan independently following their departure from the Korean agency. On April 10, 2025, they announced the release of the digital single “We Are The One (with MYNAME),” featuring members Insoo, Gunwoo, and Seyong, in advance of their Japanese concert MYNAME Live 2025 – Blooming Days. Two days later, on April 12, the group revealed plans for their first Japanese mini album, Vivid, set to be released on July 2.
